facts.fact: StackAdapt's graphic designer Phuong Nguyen describes a four-phase graphic design process: definition, creation, delivery, and feedback.
facts.quote: In my approach to graphic design I work through four phases: Definition, creation, delivery, and feedback.

facts.fact: Phuong Nguyen's role includes creating motion graphics and editing videos for StackAdapt's educational channels such as StackAdapt Academy.
facts.quote: I specialize in creating motion graphics, as well as editing videos for our educational channels like StackAdapt Academy.

facts.fact: Phuong Nguyen states that they are responsible for keeping StackAdapt branding consistent across all content.
facts.quote: I am responsible for keeping StackAdapt branding consistent across all our content.

facts.fact: According to the StackAdapt designer, programmatic advertising is intangible, which makes it hard to express visually.
facts.quote: The challenge is that programmatic advertising is intangible, which makes it hard to express visually.

facts.fact: This StackAdapt 'Life in Adtech' blog post was published on July 7, 2022.
